{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''TECO SeaCoast Pipeline Project''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Interconnects with Florida Gas Transmission and Southern Natural Gas pipelines, Florida, Florida to Greenland Energy Center, southeast Jacksonville, Duval County, Florida.

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''SeaCoast Gas Transmission LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.industrialinfo.com/news/article/seacoast-gas-transmission-plans-a-new-natural-gas-pipeline-in-florida--137181|title=industrialinfo.com|website=industrialinfo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''50 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.industrialinfo.com/news/article/seacoast-gas-transmission-plans-a-new-natural-gas-pipeline-in-florida--137181|title=industrialinfo.com|website=industrialinfo.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2008<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.floridapsc.com/library/Orders/2008/10501-2008.pdf|title=floridapsc.com|website=floridapsc.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$75,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
